'''The Scrabbler''' was a [[tineback]] that lived on [[Ruhnuk]] during the time of the [[Third Galactic War]]. It killed [[Orm Kreg]], and swallowed a vial of [[the Buzz]] that Orm was carrying. It was eventually killed in kind by the [[Alliance Commander]].<ref name="RelicHunt" />
